items: Announced in Budget 2023-24 by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, focuses on
decarbonizing India's energy and industrial sectors.
o Objective: Promote green hydrogen to reduce carbon emissions, enhance energy security, and
make India a global leader in green hydrogen production.
 Produce 5 MMT of green hydrogen by 2030.
 Reduce fuel imports by ₹1 lakh crore.
 Attract ₹8 lakh crore in investments and generate 6 lakh jobs.
 Decarbonize industries like steel, cement, and refineries.
 Foster infrastructure for hydrogen production, storage, and distribution.
 Integrate green hydrogen with renewable energy sources for grid stability.
